biotools.summary: PolyAMiner-Bulk is a deep learning algorithm that decodes alternative polyadenylation (APA) dynamics from bulk RNA-seq data. It resolves overlapping cleavage and polyadenylation sites and generates visualizations to illustrate APA dynamics.
